controls.title: Mandatory MFA for privileged accounts
controls.objective: MFA is enforced for all privileged admin accounts on KRL-ADM
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that mfa_admin is true
controls.risk: Without MFA for admins, stolen credentials allow full takeover of critical functions with no second barrier
controls.recommendation: Enable mandatory MFA for all privileged accounts by setting mfa_admin to true

controls.title: Mandatory MFA for users of critical system
controls.objective: MFA is enforced for standard users because KRL-ADM supports critical or important functions
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that mfa_users is true
controls.risk: Without MFA for all users, compromised user credentials allow unauthorized access to critical functions
controls.recommendation: Enable mandatory MFA for standard users by setting mfa_users to true

controls.title: Strong password policy
controls.objective: Passwords require a minimum length of 12 characters with complexity requirements enabled
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify password_min_length and password_require_complexity
controls.risk: Weak or short passwords can be guessed or brute-forced, enabling unauthorized access to the system
controls.recommendation: Enforce a minimum password length of 12 characters with complexity by correcting the password settings

controls.title: Account lockout after failed logins
controls.objective: Accounts lock after at most 5 failed login attempts and lockout is never disabled
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that lockout_threshold is between 1 and 5 inclusive
controls.risk: Without lockout, attackers can perform unlimited password-guessing attacks against accounts
controls.recommendation: Configure account lockout to 5 attempts at most by setting lockout_threshold between 1 and 5

controls.title: Inactive session timeout
controls.objective: Inactive sessions expire after at most 15 minutes and expiration is never disabled
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that session_timeout_minutes is between 1 and 15 inclusive
controls.risk: Unlimited inactive sessions allow session hijacking and unauthorized use of unattended workstations
controls.recommendation: Enforce inactive session expiration at 15 minutes at most by setting session_timeout_minutes between 1 and 15

controls.title: Logging of administration actions
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that admin_audit_log is true
controls.risk: Without admin audit logging, privileged actions cannot be traced, preventing detection and investigation of abuse
controls.recommendation: Enable logging of all administration actions by setting admin_audit_log to true

controls.title: No generic or shared admin accounts
controls.objective: No account with role admin is generic or shared and every admin has a nominative login of the form initiale.nom with a personal email
controls.test_procedure: Retrieve all accounts via GET /api/users and verify that every user with role admin has a nominative login and a personal email without function identifier or shared mailbox
controls.expected: for all users where role == admin: login matches initiale.nom pattern and email is personal, with no function login and no shared mailbox
controls.risk: Generic or shared admin accounts destroy individual accountability and prevent attribution of privileged actions
controls.recommendation: Remove or disable generic and shared admin accounts and replace them with dedicated nominative accounts
